prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Interact with Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to access options, hide to system tray, or start a chat session.", "Got It"]
1: []
2: ["Rendering pet desktop assets", "Checking desktop display permission"]
3: ["Preview Your Custom Pet", "Here is how your companion will appear on your desktop screen.", "Looks Great!"]
4: ["You can minimize this window. We will notify you on your desktop when your pet is ready!"]
5: ["Save Your Pet to Your Account", "Sign in to keep your pet safe, sync progress across devices, and restore your pet anytime.", "Sign In & Save Pet"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Use the desktop tray icon or click directly on your pet to interact, chat, or access settings.", "Quick Tips"]
7: ["Upload Photo or Choose a Preset Template", "Upload photos of your pet or pick from high-quality pre-designed templates.", "Starter Templates"]
8: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Pick a ready-made companion or build a unique pet from your own photos in seconds."]
9: ["Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime on your desktop to summon or talk to your pet!"]
